description: Implementation of a custom InputStream (NioBufferedFileInputStream) that uses direct buffers to efficiently read files with minimal copying, leveraging Java NIO features and resource cleanup via Cleaner.

classes.name: NioBufferedFileInputStream
classes.description: A custom InputStream that reads files using direct ByteBuffer and FileChannel, with resource cleanup via Java Cleaner.

classes.name: ResourceCleaner
classes.description: A record implementing Runnable to close FileChannel and dispose ByteBuffer during cleanup.

methods.name: NioBufferedFileInputStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer and file channel, registering cleanup.

methods.name: refill
methods.description: Refills the buffer from the file channel if empty.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a single byte from the buffer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads bytes into an array with offset and length.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns number of remaining bytes in buffer.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips n bytes, possibly from buffer or file channel.

methods.name: skipFromFileChannel
methods.description: Skips bytes directly in the file channel.
